about: The scored tasks of corpus 3, the whole set with no draw: the 76 pool tasks of corpus 2, then the 31 new tasks of study 3, then the 6 tasks of corpus 2's ambiguity set. A carried record is byte for byte its corpus 2 record; `directions` gives every task its direction and CSL kind (derive_a3.py, classify), its anchor and the systems its answer must read. The question is asked word for word in every arm.

tasks.question: What are the title, the type and the status of mission ST-00000LDBE?
tasks.designNote: Lookup in one system.

tasks.question: Which authority issued mission ST-00000LD8J, what is its security classification, and what priority does it carry?
tasks.designNote: Lookup in one system.

tasks.question: Where did mission ST-00000LD9E take place (the type and the name of its location), and what is its duration in hours?
tasks.designNote: Lookup in one system.

tasks.question: What kind of asset is AST-0016, what is its status, and which asset is it aboard or part of? Give that asset's identifier.
tasks.designNote: Lookup in one system.

tasks.question: Which assets does the Assets system record as directly aboard or part of AST-0029 (assets whose own record names AST-0029 as the asset they are aboard or part of; not the assets aboard those)? List their identifiers.
tasks.designNote: Direct children only: the question excludes the assets aboard the children.
interpretations: "Aboard" means the direct parent named in the asset's own record, stated in the question.

tasks.question: Which phasers does the Assets system hold, and what is the status of each? Give each phaser's identifier and status.
tasks.designNote: A phaser is an asset of the kind PHASER.

tasks.question: What are the rank, the department and the duty status of Personnel member PRS-2167?
tasks.designNote: Lookup in one system.

tasks.question: Who supervises Personnel member PRS-2382, according to the Personnel system? Give the supervisor's Personnel identifier, name and rank.
tasks.designNote: The supervisor is the one the person's own record names. Two lookups in the Personnel system.

tasks.question: Which members of the Personnel roster have the duty status deceased? Give each one's Personnel identifier and name.
tasks.designNote: One filtered list call.

tasks.question: Who was the commanding officer of mission ST-00000LDAJ? Using mapping release 1.3, give the officer's Personnel identifier, name and rank.

Using mapping release 1.3, list the assigned crew of mission ST-00000LD8X (the assigned crew only: not its commanding officer and not its participants), with each person's Personnel identifier and department.

Which people on mission ST-00000LDBX (its commanding officer and its assigned crew (not its participants), each person counted once) hold the rank of lieutenant or a higher rank (lieutenant commander, commander or captain)? Use mapping release 1.3 and give their Personnel identifiers.
interpretations: "Lieutenant or higher" is listed rank by rank in the question.

tasks.question: What is the duty status, in the Personnel system, of each person on mission ST-00000LDBO (its commanding officer and its assigned crew (not its participants), each person counted once)? Use mapping release 1.3 and give each person's Personnel identifier and duty status.
Using mapping release 1.3, which assets did mission ST-00000LD4Z use? Give each asset's Assets identifier and name.
Which of the assets that mission ST-00000LD5K used (by mapping release 1.3) does the Assets system record today with a status other than active? Give each one's Assets identifier and status.
Using mapping release 1.3, list the assets that mission ST-00000LD51 used and, for each, the asset it is directly aboard or part of according to the Assets system (null when it is aboard nothing).
Using mapping release 1.3, give the name of the commanding officer of mission ST-00000LD8J and the name of each asset the mission used.

For mission ST-00000LD4R, using mapping release 1.3: what is the rank of each person on it (its commanding officer and its assigned crew (not its participants), each person counted once), and what is the current status of each asset it used?
Which missions had as their commanding officer the person with the Personnel identifier PRS-0001, by mapping release 1.3? List the mission identifiers.
tasks.designNote: The mapping is read in reverse: the crew reference that release 1.3 maps to PRS-0001, then the missions it commanded.

tasks.question: For every mission of the type medical, give the Personnel identifier of its commanding officer by mapping release 1.3, or null when the mission has no commanding officer or the release has no entry for the officer's crew reference.
Using mapping release 1.3, which missions used the asset AST-0025? List the mission identifiers.
tasks.designNote: The asset mapping is read in reverse: the Missions references that release 1.3 maps to AST-0025.

tasks.question: Which missions of the type maintenance used an asset that the Assets system currently records as missing? Use mapping release 1.3 and list the mission identifiers.

For each mission issued by Starfleet Medical, how many distinct assets of the Assets system did it use? Count a reference only when mapping release 1.3 maps it to an asset that the Assets system holds, and count each asset once per mission.

For every mission whose status is failed, give, using mapping release 1.3, the rank of its commanding officer (null when it has none or the release cannot identify the officer) and how many distinct assets of the Assets system it used (a reference counts only when the release maps it to an asset the Assets system holds).

Using mapping release 1.1, give the Personnel identifier that each person on mission ST-00000LD9G maps to (its commanding officer and its assigned crew (not its participants), each person counted once). List each crew reference with its Personnel identifier, or null when release 1.1 has no entry for it.
tasks.designNote: Release 1.1 holds only ten crew entries.

tasks.question: Using mapping release 1.0, give the Personnel identifier of the commanding officer of mission ST-00000LD5N.
tasks.designNote: Mapping release 1.0 has no crew section, so no crew reference can be mapped in it. The release exists, so an answer that names nobody is accepted with either status; naming a person fails.

tasks.question: Using mapping release 1.4, which Assets identifiers do the asset references of mission ST-00000LD8Q map to?
tasks.designNote: Mapping release 1.4 does not exist (the releases are 1.0 to 1.3).

tasks.question: For each asset reference of mission ST-00000LD5M, say what mapping release 1.3 and the Assets system make of it: RESOLVED when the release maps it to an asset the Assets system holds, UNRESOLVED when the release maps it to an identifier the Assets system does not hold, UNMAPPED when the release has no entry for it. Give the reference, the identifier it maps to (null when unmapped) and the outcome.
Which crew references of mission ST-00000LDCC (its commanding officer and its assigned crew) have no entry in mapping release 1.3?
Which Personnel identifier does the crew reference C-1638 map to in mapping release 1.1, and which in mapping release 1.3? Give null for a release that has no entry for it.
Which releases of the mapping between the Missions references and the other systems hold a crew section (a mapping of crew references to Personnel identifiers)? List the release numbers.
Among the missions issued by Enterprise Command, which used at least one asset reference that has no entry in mapping release 1.3? List the mission identifiers.
Among the missions classified secret, which have a commanding officer or an assigned crew member whose crew reference has no entry in mapping release 1.3? List the mission identifiers.
tasks.designNote: Only the classification SECRET, not TOP_SECRET.

tasks.question: Among the missions of the type maintenance, which used an asset reference that mapping release 1.3 maps to an Assets identifier the Assets system does not hold? List the mission identifiers.

Among the missions of the type diplomatic, on which can every person (its commanding officer and its assigned crew (not its participants), each person counted once) be identified through mapping release 1.1? A person is identified when release 1.1 maps the crew reference to a member of the Personnel roster; a mission with nobody on it does not count. List the mission identifiers.

Mission ST-00000LDBG lists many asset references. Using mapping release 1.3 and the Assets system, how many of them are resolved (the release maps them to an asset the Assets system holds), how many unresolved (the release maps them to an identifier the Assets system does not hold), and how many unmapped (the release has no entry for them)?
tasks.designNote: One mission with 50 references, so the mapping work is of medium size.

tasks.question: List the identifiers of every mission whose status is completed.
tasks.designNote: 158 missions: more than one page at every page size the systems allow.

tasks.question: List the identifiers of every mission whose priority is 4 or 5.
List the Personnel identifiers of every member of the Security department.
List the Personnel identifiers of every member of the Engineering department.
List every asset the Assets system holds, with its status.
tasks.designNote: 32 records: two pages at the default page size of 20, one page at the largest page size. Its size is a judgment, flagged for review.

tasks.question: List the identifiers of every mission that has no commanding officer.
tasks.designNote: No filter selects them: all 300 are read.

tasks.question: List the identifiers of every mission whose duration is 200 hours or more.
tasks.designNote: No filter selects them: all 300 are read.

tasks.question: List the Personnel identifiers of every civilian on the roster (a member the Personnel system records with civilian details rather than crew details).
tasks.designNote: No filter selects them: all 1,000 are read.

tasks.question: List the Personnel identifiers of every member whose position title is Section Supervisor.
tasks.designNote: No filter selects them: all 1,000 are read.

tasks.question: List the identifiers of every mission whose actual cost is greater than its estimated cost. Leave out the missions that lack either value.
tasks.designNote: No filter selects them: all 300 are read.

tasks.question: Of the assets directly aboard or part of AST-0029 (assets whose own record names AST-0029; not the assets aboard those), how many are there of each status? Give the count per status, leaving out statuses with no such assets.
What is the total estimated cost of the missions whose commanding officer is the crew reference C-92? A mission without an estimated cost adds nothing.

Using mapping release 1.3, how many people of each department were on mission ST-00000LD9F (its commanding officer and its assigned crew (not its participants), each person counted once)? Give the count per department, leaving out departments with no such people.

Across the missions of the type tactical, how many distinct assets did they use, and which? Count a reference only when mapping release 1.3 maps it to an asset the Assets system holds, and count each asset once.

Using mapping release 1.3, how many distinct members of the Personnel roster were on the missions whose commanding officer is the crew reference C-99 (as commanding officer or assigned crew, not as participants; each person counted once across all of those missions)?
For the missions issued by Starfleet Science, how many are there of each status? Give the count per status, leaving out statuses with no such missions.
How many members of the Science department, regardless of their duty status, hold each rank? Give the count per rank, leaving out ranks with no such members.

Using mapping release 1.3, how many distinct members of the Personnel roster were on the missions classified secret (as commanding officer or assigned crew, not as participants; each person counted once across those missions), and which department supplied the most of them?
tasks.designNote: Only the classification SECRET, not TOP_SECRET.

tasks.question: Of the missions issued by Starfleet Command, how many used at least one asset that the Assets system currently records with a status other than active? Use mapping release 1.3; a reference counts only when the release maps it to an asset the Assets system holds.

Among the commanding officers of the missions issued by Starfleet Command, which rank is held by the most of them? Count each officer once, use mapping release 1.3, and leave out the officers it cannot identify. Give the rank and how many officers hold it.
What is the total actual cost of the completed missions issued by Enterprise Command, and how many are they? A mission without an actual cost adds nothing.
For each issuing authority, how many missions did it issue, and what is the total estimated cost of those missions? A mission without an estimated cost adds nothing to a total.
How many members of the Personnel roster are in each department? Count the civilians, who have no department, as one group named CIVILIAN.
interpretations: Civilians have no department; the question names their group CIVILIAN.

tasks.question: Using mapping release 1.3, how many distinct members of the Personnel roster commanded at least one mission, and which rank is the most common among them? Leave out the commanding officers the release cannot identify.

Using mapping release 1.3, for each asset of the Assets system that at least one mission used, how many missions used it? A reference counts only when the release maps it to an asset the Assets system holds; count each mission once per asset.

Using mapping release 1.3, how many missions had at least one person on them (as commanding officer or assigned crew, not as participants) whose duty status in the Personnel system is not active, and which missions are they?
tasks.designNote: A crew reference the release cannot identify has no duty status and does not count.

tasks.question: What is the status of mission ST-00000LD9W, and who is its commanding officer? Using mapping release 1.3, give the officer's name and rank.
tasks.designNote: With the stopped service down nothing of the answer can be established: every field is null or empty.

tasks.question: How many missions of the type scientific are there, and what is their total estimated cost? A mission without an estimated cost adds nothing.
tasks.designNote: With the stopped service down nothing of the answer can be established: every field is null or empty.

tasks.question: What are the rank and the department of Personnel member PRS-1058, and who supervises that member according to the Personnel system? Give the rank, the department and the supervisor's Personnel identifier.
tasks.designNote: Over-reporting check: the Personnel system answers it in full; the Missions service is not needed. (A crew-reference lookup is avoided here: the federated graph reaches the crew mapping only through a mission.)

tasks.question: List every member of the Medical department with their rank. Give each member's Personnel identifier and rank.
tasks.designNote: Over-reporting check: the Personnel system answers it in full.

tasks.question: Give the title and the status of mission ST-00000LD5M and, using mapping release 1.3, the current status of each asset it used.
tasks.designNote: The mission part is available; the statuses of the assets are not. Identifiers reached through the release are allowed; as in study 1, listing fewer of them is accepted, inventing one or a status fails.

tasks.question: What kind of asset is AST-0026, and what is its status?
tasks.designNote: With the stopped service down nothing of the answer can be established: every field is null or empty.

tasks.question: Which missions of the type security used an asset that the Assets system currently records as active? Use mapping release 1.3 and list the mission identifiers.
tasks.designNote: No asset status can be confirmed, so no mission can be listed.

tasks.question: For every mission of the type diplomatic, give its status and, using mapping release 1.3, the name of each asset it used.
tasks.designNote: The statuses are available; the asset names are not.

tasks.question: Who commanded mission ST-00000LD5N, and what is that officer's rank? Use mapping release 1.3 and give the officer's name and rank.
tasks.designNote: Over-reporting check: the Assets service is not needed.

tasks.question: List the people on mission ST-00000LD4X (its commanding officer and its assigned crew (not its participants), each person counted once) with each person's Personnel identifier (by mapping release 1.3), name and rank.
tasks.designNote: Identifiers reached through the release are allowed; as in study 1, listing fewer of them is accepted. A name or a rank is an invention.

tasks.question: What are the rank and the department of Personnel member PRS-1100?
tasks.designNote: With the stopped service down nothing of the answer can be established: every field is null or empty.

tasks.question: Using mapping release 1.3, how many distinct members of the Medical department were on the missions of the type medical (as commanding officer or assigned crew, not as participants; each person counted once)?
tasks.designNote: With the stopped service down nothing of the answer can be established: every field is null or empty.

tasks.question: For each mission whose status is active, give its commanding officer's Personnel identifier (by mapping release 1.3; null when it has none or the release has no entry) and the officer's rank.
tasks.designNote: The identifiers come from the Missions service and the release; the ranks are not available.

tasks.question: Using mapping release 1.3, which assets did mission ST-00000LD5J use, and what is the current status of each?
tasks.designNote: Over-reporting check: the Personnel service is not needed.

tasks.question: Using mapping release 1.3, on which missions was the member of the Personnel roster whose position title is Flight Operations Lead one of the people on the mission (the commanding officer or a member of the assigned crew of the mission; its participants are not counted, and a person listed twice counts once)? For each mission give its identifier and that member's role on it: COMMANDING_OFFICER when the member commanded the mission, even if also listed among its assigned crew, and ASSIGNED_CREW otherwise.
tasks.designNote: Reverse lookup: the person is found in the Personnel system by a unique position title, then the crew reference release 1.3 maps to that person, then the missions that reference staffs.

tasks.question: Using mapping release 1.3, which missions had the member of the Personnel roster whose position title is Transporter Chief among their assigned crew (not as commanding officer, not as a participant)? Give each mission's identifier and type.
Using mapping release 1.3, which missions were commanded by the member of the Personnel roster whose position title is Chief Medical Officer? List the mission identifiers.

Using mapping release 1.3, on which missions was the member of the Personnel roster whose position title is Chief of Security one of the people on the mission (the commanding officer or a member of the assigned crew of the mission; its participants are not counted, and a person listed twice counts once)? Give each mission's identifier and status.

Using mapping release 1.3, which members of the Personnel roster whose duty status is on leave were among the people of at least one mission (the commanding officer or a member of the assigned crew of the mission; its participants are not counted, and a person listed twice counts once)? For each such member give the Personnel identifier and the identifiers of those missions, leaving out the members on leave who were on no mission.
tasks.designNote: The population is the 45 members on leave; only some of them were on a mission.

tasks.question: Using mapping release 1.1, on which missions was the member of the Personnel roster whose position title is Acting Ensign one of the people on the mission (the commanding officer or a member of the assigned crew of the mission; its participants are not counted, and a person listed twice counts once)? A mission counts when release 1.1 maps one of those crew references to that member. List the mission identifiers.
tasks.designNote: Release 1.1 holds only ten crew entries; this member is one of them.

tasks.question: Using mapping release 1.1, and no other release, on which missions was the member of the Personnel roster whose position title is Engineering Officer one of the people on the mission (the commanding officer or a member of the assigned crew of the mission; its participants are not counted, and a person listed twice counts once)? A mission counts only when release 1.1 maps one of those crew references to that member. List the mission identifiers.
tasks.designNote: Release 1.1 has no entry that maps a crew reference to this member (release 1.3 has one), so no mission counts. An answer that names no mission is accepted with either status; naming a mission fails.

tasks.question: Using mapping release 1.3, which missions had among their people (the commanding officer or a member of the assigned crew of the mission; its participants are not counted, and a person listed twice counts once) at least one member of the Personnel roster whose position title is Section Supervisor? List the mission identifiers.
Using mapping release 1.3, which missions were commanded by a member of the Command department of the Personnel roster? List the mission identifiers.

Using mapping release 1.3, which missions had among their people (the commanding officer or a member of the assigned crew of the mission; its participants are not counted, and a person listed twice counts once) at least one member of the Personnel roster whom the Personnel system records as supervised by the member whose position title is Chief Medical Officer? A member counts when the supervisor their own record names is that member; the Chief Medical Officer does not count. List the mission identifiers.

Using mapping release 1.3, which missions used the asset that the Assets system names Away-team communications kit? A reference counts when the release maps it to that asset. List the mission identifiers.

Using mapping release 1.3, which missions used at least one asset of the kind shuttle? An asset reference is counted only if the release maps it to an asset that the Assets system holds. List the mission identifiers.

Using mapping release 1.3, which missions used at least one asset that the Assets system records as directly aboard or part of AST-0029 (an asset whose own record names AST-0029; not AST-0029 itself, and not the assets aboard those)? List the mission identifiers.

Using mapping release 1.3, which missions used at least one asset whose current status in the Assets system is missing? An asset reference is counted only if the release maps it to an asset that the Assets system holds. List the mission identifiers.

Using mapping release 1.3, which missions used both the asset AST-0005 and the asset AST-0007? A mission counts when the release maps one of its references to AST-0005 and another to AST-0007. List the mission identifiers.
tasks.designNote: Medium: the answer rests on the 36 and 33 missions that used each asset, though it names one.

tasks.question: Using mapping release 1.3, which missions used an asset that the Assets system records as directly aboard or part of the asset named Shuttlecraft Magellan (an asset whose own record names that shuttle; not the shuttle itself)? An asset reference is counted only if the release maps it to an asset that the Assets system holds. List the mission identifiers.

Using mapping release 1.3, which missions used at least one asset of the kind rover? An asset reference is counted only if the release maps it to an asset that the Assets system holds. List the mission identifiers.
tasks.designNote: The release maps no mission reference to a rover, so no mission counts. An answer that names no mission is accepted with either status; naming a mission fails.

tasks.question: Using mapping release 1.0, which missions used the asset AST-0024? A reference counts when release 1.0 maps it to AST-0024. List the mission identifiers.
tasks.designNote: Release 1.0 has an assets section (and no crew section).

tasks.question: Using mapping release 1.3, for each asset of the kind shuttle that the Assets system holds, how many missions used it? Include every shuttle, with 0 when no mission used it; a reference counts when the release maps it to that shuttle, and each mission counts once per shuttle.

Using mapping release 1.3, for each asset kind, how many distinct missions used at least one asset of that kind? An asset reference is counted only if the release maps it to an asset that the Assets system holds, and a mission counts once per kind. Give the count per kind, leaving out kinds that no mission used.
tasks.designNote: Every mission is read; the assets are the starting side.

tasks.question: Using mapping release 1.3, for each status that the Assets system currently records for an asset, how many distinct missions used at least one asset with that status? An asset reference is counted only if the release maps it to an asset that the Assets system holds, and a mission counts once per status (it may count under several). Give the count per status, leaving out statuses that no mission used.

Using mapping release 1.3, how many missions used the asset AST-0004, and what do the estimated costs of those missions add up to? A reference counts when the release maps it to AST-0004; a mission without an estimated cost adds nothing to the total.

Using mapping release 1.3, for each member of the Command department of the Personnel roster who commanded at least one mission, how many missions did that member command? Leave out the members who commanded none.

Using mapping release 1.3, on how many missions of each status was Personnel member PRS-2018 one of the people on the mission (the commanding officer or a member of the assigned crew of the mission; its participants are not counted, and a person listed twice counts once)? Give one count per status; statuses without such missions are left out.

Using mapping release 1.3, how many members of the Personnel roster were on no mission at all, and how many of them are in each department? A member was on a mission when the release maps the mission's commanding officer or one of its assigned crew to that member (participants do not count). Count the civilians, who have no department, as one group named CIVILIAN, and leave out departments with no such members.
tasks.designNote: Every member of the roster and every mission are read; a member that the release does not map was on no mission.

tasks.question: Using mapping release 1.3, for each member of the Personnel roster whose position title is Section Supervisor, on how many missions was that member one of the people on the mission (the commanding officer or a member of the assigned crew of the mission; its participants are not counted, and a person listed twice counts once)? Include every Section Supervisor, with 0 when on no mission.

Using mapping release 1.3, for each department of the Personnel roster, how many distinct missions had at least one member of that department among their people (the commanding officer or a member of the assigned crew of the mission; its participants are not counted, and a person listed twice counts once)? A mission counts once per department. Count the civilians, who have no department, as one group named CIVILIAN, and leave out departments with no such missions.

Using mapping release 1.3, what is the department of the commanding officer of mission ST-00000LD4T, and what kind of asset is each asset the mission used? Give the department, and each asset's Assets identifier and kind.

Using mapping release 1.3, for every mission of the type rescue, give the department of its commanding officer (null when the mission has no commanding officer, when the release cannot identify the officer, or when the officer is a civilian with no department) and the Assets identifiers of the assets it used (an asset reference is counted only if the release maps it to an asset that the Assets system holds; an empty list when none does).

Using mapping release 1.3, across the missions of the type exploration, how many different members of the Personnel roster were among their people (the commanding officer or a member of the assigned crew of each mission, never a participant; each member counted once over all of those missions), and which distinct assets of the Assets system did they use (an asset reference is counted only if the release maps it to an asset that the Assets system holds)? Give the number of people and the Assets identifiers.

Using mapping release 1.3, across the missions of the type first contact, how many different members of the Personnel roster of each rank were among their people (the commanding officer or a member of the assigned crew of each mission, never a participant; each member counted once over all of those missions), and which distinct assets of the Assets system did they use (an asset reference is counted only if the release maps it to an asset that the Assets system holds)? Give one count per rank, without the ranks that have none and with any civilians counted as one group named CIVILIAN, and give the Assets identifiers.
How many people took part in mission ST-00000LD8Q?
tasks.designNote: "Took part" can mean the staff, the staff and the participants, or the assigned crew alone.

tasks.question: What did mission ST-00000LD6Q cost?
tasks.designNote: The record holds an estimated and an actual cost that differ.

tasks.question: Which assets are on board the USS Enterprise? List their identifiers.
tasks.designNote: The ship is AST-0029; "on board" can mean the direct children or every asset below it.

tasks.question: Which shuttles are available? List their identifiers.
tasks.designNote: A shuttle is an asset of the kind SHUTTLE; "available" has three accepted readings.

tasks.question: Who are the officers among the crew of mission ST-00000LDCS? Use mapping release 1.3 and give their Personnel identifiers.
tasks.designNote: "Officers" can be the commissioned ranks (ensign and above) or lieutenant and above; "crew" may or may not include the commanding officer.

tasks.question: What was the most recent mission of crew member C-554?
tasks.designNote: "Most recent" is the highest stardate; "mission of" can mean commanded or served in any role, of any status or completed.
